QuestInfo.name: Wrinkle Woes
QuestInfo.0: Corba, Leafre's sage, was so old that no one dared to guess his age. But something was troubling him lately...
QuestInfo.1: Corba is worried abou this crow's feet wrinkles around his eyes. He thinks putting #r#t4000916##k around his eyes to massage it would be the best way to prevent any more wrinkles. He wants you to bring him #t4000916# but since #t4000916# has poison in it, he wants you to find out from #bKumo#k how to remove the posion.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #t4000916# for Corba for the wrinkles but Kumo found out about Corba's secret! Corba believes his secrets will spread through the town in no time since Kumo is the biggest gossiper in town.

0.0: Broth made me strong! I feel like I could defeat a Kentaurus King with one hand tied around my back. But what good is strength when my face is covered in wrinkles? I need to rub #r#t4000916##k in my face to get rid of wrinkles...
0.1: Oh, heavens no. I'm not forcing you! Just a suggestion that you don't let an old man rot. So... Wanna help?

yes.0: Wrinkle treatment is simple. Rub #r#t4000916##k in face every day for one week. My face is small, so I only need 5. Will you help?
yes.1: But! #r#t4000916##k is poisonous, unless treated. #bKumo#k can get rid of the poison! Talk to #bKumo#k on your way back, and remember, don't tell a soul!

no.0: No time for the elderly, eh?

yes.0: W-what? Kumo knows? Hm... What to do... It's just a matter of time until everyone knows...
yes.1: Kumo can't be trusted. We might as well trust a fox to herd a flock of geese! Oh, this is going to end poorly.\r\n

default.0: Get 5 #r#t4000916##k items, then talk to #bKumo#k to get rid of the poison.
